mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800 units, indicating strengthening demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1800 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other market conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month, indicating supply chain resilience, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive return difference (t-test p > 0.05) between triggered and non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) surpassing $370,000 million, signaling robust demand, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and retail sector performance
failure_condition: SPX fails to deliver positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds $370,000 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.2% month-over-month, indicating easing inflation pressures, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis reveals no significant difference in SPX returns (t-test p > 0.05) between periods with and without the CPI decrease trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by less than 50,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, the combined labor market weakness predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and recession signals
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 2.5% quarter-over-quarter, signaling strong economic expansion, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive return difference (t-test p > 0.05) between GDP growth periods and non-growth periods during non-recessionary regimes.
